完整数值定义（Python算式/递推；self缓存改为局部变量即可）：self._high=H；self._low=L；self._close=C；self._window=20；self._window_atr=10；self._fillna=False；self._original_version=True；self._multiplier=2；_run: min_periods = 1 if self._fillna else self._window
if self._original_version:
self._tp = ((self._high + self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=min_periods).mean()
self._tp_high = ((4 * self._high - 2 * self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=0).mean()
self._tp_low = ((-2 * self._high + 4 * self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=0).mean()
else:
self._tp = self._close.ewm(span=self._window, min_periods=min_periods, adjust=False).mean()
atr = AverageTrueRange(close=self._close, high=self._high, low=self._low, window=self._window_atr, fillna=self._fillna).average_true_range()
self._tp_high = self._tp + self._multiplier * atr
self._tp_low = self._tp - self._multiplier * atr；keltner_channel_wband: wband = (self._tp_high - self._tp_low) / self._tp * 100
wband = self._check_fillna(wband, value=0)
return pd.Series(wband, name='bbiwband')；辅助算子 _true_range(high: pd.Series, low: pd.Series, prev_close: pd.Series): tr1 = high - low
tr2 = (high - prev_close).abs()
tr3 = (low - prev_close).abs()
true_range = pd.DataFrame(data={'tr1': tr1, 'tr2': tr2, 'tr3': tr3}).max(axis=1)
return true_range；self._check_fillna(x,...)在fillna=False时等于x，不执行任何补齐。；原目录：KeltnerChannel.keltner_channel_wband（window=20, window_atr=10, original_version=True, multiplier=2）；追踪：PF00897；[来源](https://github.com/bukosabino/ta)。

input_roles.definition:
固定公开源码默认参数：{'column': 'close'}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：OBV(cls, ohlcv: DataFrame, column: str='close'): ohlcv['OBV'] = np.nan
neg_change = ohlcv[column] < ohlcv[column].shift(1)
pos_change = ohlcv[column] >= ohlcv[column].shift(1)
no_change = ohlcv[column] == ohlcv[column].shift(1)
if pos_change.any():
ohlcv.loc[pos_change, 'OBV'] = ohlcv['volume']
if neg_change.any():

if no_change.any():

return pd.Series(ohlcv['OBV'].cumsum(), name='OBV')；原目录：OBV（无固定窗口）；追踪：PF01009；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。

input_roles.definition:
完整数值定义（逐股数组/Series算法，仅返回meta.name对应的主列）：参数meta.window=14，meta.column=close，meta.as_int/int0/int1按固定窗口取值；固定类常量={}；_get_atr(self, meta: _Meta): window = meta.as_int
self[meta.name] = self._atr(window)；_atr(self, window): tr = self._tr()
return self.smma(tr, window)；_tr(self): prev_close = self._shift_arr(self.close.values, -1)
high = self.high.values
low = self.low.values
c1 = high - low
c2 = np.abs(high - prev_close)
c3 = np.abs(low - prev_close)
tr = np.maximum(c1, np.maximum(c2, c3))
np.nan_to_num(tr, copy=False)
return self.to_series(tr)；smma(series, window): return series.ewm(ignore_na=False, alpha=1.0 / window, min_periods=0, adjust=True).mean()；_shift_arr(arr: np.ndarray, window: int): out = np.empty_like(arr)
if window < 0:
k = -window
out[:k] = arr[0]
out[k:] = arr[:-k]
else:
k = window
out[:-k] = arr[k:]
out[-k:] = arr[-1]
return out；to_series(self, arr: Union[list, np.ndarray]): return pd.Series(arr, index=self.close.index).fillna(0)；原目录：atr（窗口=14）；追踪：PF01491；[来源](https://github.com/jealous/stockstats)。

固定公开源码默认参数：{'period': 14}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：ATR(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=14): TR = cls.TR(ohlc)

return pd.Series((BB['BB_UPPER'] - BB['BB_LOWER']) / BB['BB_MIDDLE'], name='{0} period BBWITH'.format(period))；BBANDS(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=20, MA: Series=None, column: str='close', std_multiplier: float=2): std = ohlc[column].rolling(window=period).std()

return pd.concat([upper_bb, middle_band, lower_bb], axis=1)；SMA(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=41, column: str='close'): return pd.Series(ohlc[column].rolling(window=period).mean(), name='{0} period SMA'.format(period))；原目录：BBWIDTH（period=20, MA=None）；追踪：PF00992；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。

input_roles.definition: 源码核心递推表达式（完整分支/参数见链接）：tempReal = inHigh[i] + inLow[i];；tempReal = 4 * (inHigh[i] - inLow[i]) / tempReal;；periodTotalUpper += inHigh[i] * (1 + tempReal);；periodTotalLower += inLow[i] * (1 - tempReal);；periodTotalUpper += inHigh[i];；periodTotalLower += inLow[i];；periodTotalMiddle += inClose[i];；i = i + 1;；tempReal = inHigh[trailingIdx] + inLow[trailingIdx];；tempReal = 4 * (inHigh[trailingIdx] - inLow[trailingIdx]) / tempReal;；periodTotalUpper -= inHigh[trailingIdx] * (1 + tempReal);；periodTotalLower -= inLow[trailingIdx] * (1 - tempReal);；trailingIdx = trailingIdx + 1;；outIdx = outIdx + 1;；本行取输出outRealLowerBand。[算法源码](https://github.com/TA-Lib/ta-lib/blob/481dda1b10350468e82221b17fe84f6bb24e122d/src/ta_func/ta_ACCBANDS.c)；默认参数={'Time Period': 20.0}；完整数值核及辅助调用在实现附录展开。；原目录：ACCBANDS.outRealLowerBand（Time Period=20）；追踪：PF00649；[来源](https://github.com/TA-Lib/ta-lib/blob/481dda1b10350468e82221b17fe84f6bb24e122d/ta_func_api.xml)。；同定义来源别名：Pandas TA Classic:accbands（length=20, mamode='sma'）

input_roles.name: ta_keltner_channel_keltner_channel_hband_20_10d
input_roles.definition:
完整数值定义（Python算式/递推；self缓存改为局部变量即可）：self._high=H；self._low=L；self._close=C；self._window=20；self._window_atr=10；self._fillna=False；self._original_version=True；self._multiplier=2；_run: min_periods = 1 if self._fillna else self._window
if self._original_version:
self._tp = ((self._high + self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=min_periods).mean()
self._tp_high = ((4 * self._high - 2 * self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=0).mean()
self._tp_low = ((-2 * self._high + 4 * self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=0).mean()
else:
self._tp = self._close.ewm(span=self._window, min_periods=min_periods, adjust=False).mean()
atr = AverageTrueRange(close=self._close, high=self._high, low=self._low, window=self._window_atr, fillna=self._fillna).average_true_range()
self._tp_high = self._tp + self._multiplier * atr
self._tp_low = self._tp - self._multiplier * atr；keltner_channel_hband: tp_high = self._check_fillna(self._tp_high, value=-1)
return pd.Series(tp_high, name='kc_hband')；辅助算子 _true_range(high: pd.Series, low: pd.Series, prev_close: pd.Series): tr1 = high - low
tr2 = (high - prev_close).abs()
tr3 = (low - prev_close).abs()
true_range = pd.DataFrame(data={'tr1': tr1, 'tr2': tr2, 'tr3': tr3}).max(axis=1)
return true_range；self._check_fillna(x,...)在fillna=False时等于x，不执行任何补齐。；原目录：KeltnerChannel.keltner_channel_hband（window=20, window_atr=10, original_version=True, multiplier=2）；追踪：PF00895；[来源](https://github.com/bukosabino/ta)。

input_roles.name: finta_vfi_130d
input_roles.definition:
固定公开源码默认参数：{'period': 130, 'smoothing_factor': 3, 'factor': 0.2, 'vfactor': 2.5, 'adjust': True}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：VFI(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=130, smoothing_factor: int=3, factor: int=0.2, vfactor: int=2.5, adjust: bool=True): typical = TA.TP(ohlc)
inter = typical.apply(np.log).diff()
vinter = inter.rolling(window=30).std()
cutoff = pd.Series(factor * vinter * ohlc['close'], name='cutoff')
price_change = pd.Series(typical.diff(), name='pc')
mav = pd.Series(ohlc['volume'].rolling(center=False, window=period).mean(), name='mav')
_va = pd.concat([ohlc['volume'], mav.shift()], axis=1)
_mp = pd.concat([price_change, cutoff], axis=1)
_mp.fillna(value=0, inplace=True)
def _vol_added(row):
""" Determine the maximum volume to be added"""
if row['volume'] > vfactor * row['mav']:
return vfactor * row['mav']
else:
return row['volume']
added_vol = _va.apply(_vol_added, axis=1)
def _multiplier(row):
"""
Determine whether the volume is up volume (multiplier +1) or
down volume (multiplier -1). If price change is smaller than cutoff
do not count volume (multipler 0).
"""
if row['pc'] > row['cutoff']:
return 1
elif row['pc'] < 0 - row['cutoff']:
return -1
else:
return 0
multiplier = _mp.apply(_multiplier, axis=1)
raw_sum = (multiplier * added_vol).rolling(window=period).sum()
raw_value = raw_sum / mav.shift()
vfi = pd.Series(raw_value.ewm(ignore_na=False, min_periods=smoothing_factor - 1, span=smoothing_factor, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='VFI')
return vfi；TP(cls, ohlc: DataFrame): return pd.Series((ohlc['high'] + ohlc['low'] + ohlc['close']) / 3, name='TP')；原目录：VFI（period=130, smoothing_factor=3, factor=0.2, vfactor=2.5）；追踪：PF01030；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。

input_roles.name: finta_vfi_130d
input_roles.definition:
固定公开源码默认参数：{'period': 130, 'smoothing_factor': 3, 'factor': 0.2, 'vfactor': 2.5, 'adjust': True}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：VFI(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=130, smoothing_factor: int=3, factor: int=0.2, vfactor: int=2.5, adjust: bool=True): typical = TA.TP(ohlc)
inter = typical.apply(np.log).diff()
vinter = inter.rolling(window=30).std()
cutoff = pd.Series(factor * vinter * ohlc['close'], name='cutoff')
price_change = pd.Series(typical.diff(), name='pc')
mav = pd.Series(ohlc['volume'].rolling(center=False, window=period).mean(), name='mav')
_va = pd.concat([ohlc['volume'], mav.shift()], axis=1)
_mp = pd.concat([price_change, cutoff], axis=1)
_mp.fillna(value=0, inplace=True)
def _vol_added(row):
""" Determine the maximum volume to be added"""
if row['volume'] > vfactor * row['mav']:
return vfactor * row['mav']
else:
return row['volume']
added_vol = _va.apply(_vol_added, axis=1)
def _multiplier(row):
"""
Determine whether the volume is up volume (multiplier +1) or
down volume (multiplier -1). If price change is smaller than cutoff
do not count volume (multipler 0).
"""
if row['pc'] > row['cutoff']:
return 1
elif row['pc'] < 0 - row['cutoff']:
return -1
else:
return 0
multiplier = _mp.apply(_multiplier, axis=1)
raw_sum = (multiplier * added_vol).rolling(window=period).sum()
raw_value = raw_sum / mav.shift()
vfi = pd.Series(raw_value.ewm(ignore_na=False, min_periods=smoothing_factor - 1, span=smoothing_factor, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='VFI')
return vfi；TP(cls, ohlc: DataFrame): return pd.Series((ohlc['high'] + ohlc['low'] + ohlc['close']) / 3, name='TP')；原目录：VFI（period=130, smoothing_factor=3, factor=0.2, vfactor=2.5）；追踪：PF01030；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。

input_roles.definition: 源码核心递推表达式（完整分支/参数见链接）：k = 2.0 / (optInTimePeriod + 1.0);；tempReal = inReal[today++];；tempReal += inReal[today++];；e1 = tempReal / optInTimePeriod;；e1 = fma(one_minus_k, e1, k * inReal[today++]);；tempReal += e1;；e2 = tempReal / optInTimePeriod;；e2 = fma(one_minus_k, e2, k * e1);；tempReal += e2;；e3 = tempReal / optInTimePeriod;；e3 = fma(one_minus_k, e3, k * e2);；tempReal += e3;；e4 = tempReal / optInTimePeriod;；e4 = fma(one_minus_k, e4, k * e3);；本行取输出outReal。[算法源码](https://github.com/TA-Lib/ta-lib/blob/481dda1b10350468e82221b17fe84f6bb24e122d/src/ta_func/ta_T3.c)；默认参数={'Time Period': 5.0, 'Volume Factor': 0.7}；完整数值核及辅助调用在实现附录展开。；原目录：T3.outReal（Time Period=5, Volume Factor=7.000000e-1）；追踪：PF00864；[来源](https://github.com/TA-Lib/ta-lib/blob/481dda1b10350468e82221b17fe84f6bb24e122d/ta_func_api.xml)。

input_roles.name: ta_bollinger_bands_bollinger_lband_20d
input_roles.definition:
完整数值定义（Python算式/递推；self缓存改为局部变量即可）：self._close=C；self._window=20；self._window_dev=2；self._fillna=False；_run: min_periods = 0 if self._fillna else self._window
self._mavg = self._close.rolling(self._window, min_periods=min_periods).mean()
self._mstd = self._close.rolling(self._window, min_periods=min_periods).std(ddof=0)
self._hband = self._mavg + self._window_dev * self._mstd
self._lband = self._mavg - self._window_dev * self._mstd；bollinger_lband: lband = self._check_fillna(self._lband, value=-1)
return pd.Series(lband, name='lband')；self._check_fillna(x,...)在fillna=False时等于x，不执行任何补齐。；原目录：BollingerBands.bollinger_lband（window=20, window_dev=2）；追踪：PF00889；[来源](https://github.com/bukosabino/ta)。

input_roles.name: finta_vfi_130d
input_roles.definition:
固定公开源码默认参数：{'period': 130, 'smoothing_factor': 3, 'factor': 0.2, 'vfactor': 2.5, 'adjust': True}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：VFI(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=130, smoothing_factor: int=3, factor: int=0.2, vfactor: int=2.5, adjust: bool=True): typical = TA.TP(ohlc)
inter = typical.apply(np.log).diff()
vinter = inter.rolling(window=30).std()
cutoff = pd.Series(factor * vinter * ohlc['close'], name='cutoff')
price_change = pd.Series(typical.diff(), name='pc')
mav = pd.Series(ohlc['volume'].rolling(center=False, window=period).mean(), name='mav')
_va = pd.concat([ohlc['volume'], mav.shift()], axis=1)
_mp = pd.concat([price_change, cutoff], axis=1)
_mp.fillna(value=0, inplace=True)
def _vol_added(row):
""" Determine the maximum volume to be added"""
if row['volume'] > vfactor * row['mav']:
return vfactor * row['mav']
else:
return row['volume']
added_vol = _va.apply(_vol_added, axis=1)
def _multiplier(row):
"""
Determine whether the volume is up volume (multiplier +1) or
down volume (multiplier -1). If price change is smaller than cutoff
do not count volume (multipler 0).
"""
if row['pc'] > row['cutoff']:
return 1
elif row['pc'] < 0 - row['cutoff']:
return -1
else:
return 0
multiplier = _mp.apply(_multiplier, axis=1)
raw_sum = (multiplier * added_vol).rolling(window=period).sum()
raw_value = raw_sum / mav.shift()
vfi = pd.Series(raw_value.ewm(ignore_na=False, min_periods=smoothing_factor - 1, span=smoothing_factor, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='VFI')
return vfi；TP(cls, ohlc: DataFrame): return pd.Series((ohlc['high'] + ohlc['low'] + ohlc['close']) / 3, name='TP')；原目录：VFI（period=130, smoothing_factor=3, factor=0.2, vfactor=2.5）；追踪：PF01030；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。

input_roles.name: finta_vfi_130d
input_roles.definition:
固定公开源码默认参数：{'period': 130, 'smoothing_factor': 3, 'factor': 0.2, 'vfactor': 2.5, 'adjust': True}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：VFI(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=130, smoothing_factor: int=3, factor: int=0.2, vfactor: int=2.5, adjust: bool=True): typical = TA.TP(ohlc)
inter = typical.apply(np.log).diff()
vinter = inter.rolling(window=30).std()
cutoff = pd.Series(factor * vinter * ohlc['close'], name='cutoff')
price_change = pd.Series(typical.diff(), name='pc')
mav = pd.Series(ohlc['volume'].rolling(center=False, window=period).mean(), name='mav')
_va = pd.concat([ohlc['volume'], mav.shift()], axis=1)
_mp = pd.concat([price_change, cutoff], axis=1)
_mp.fillna(value=0, inplace=True)
def _vol_added(row):
""" Determine the maximum volume to be added"""
if row['volume'] > vfactor * row['mav']:
return vfactor * row['mav']
else:
return row['volume']
added_vol = _va.apply(_vol_added, axis=1)
def _multiplier(row):
"""
Determine whether the volume is up volume (multiplier +1) or
down volume (multiplier -1). If price change is smaller than cutoff
do not count volume (multipler 0).
"""
if row['pc'] > row['cutoff']:
return 1
elif row['pc'] < 0 - row['cutoff']:
return -1
else:
return 0
multiplier = _mp.apply(_multiplier, axis=1)
raw_sum = (multiplier * added_vol).rolling(window=period).sum()
raw_value = raw_sum / mav.shift()
vfi = pd.Series(raw_value.ewm(ignore_na=False, min_periods=smoothing_factor - 1, span=smoothing_factor, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='VFI')
return vfi；TP(cls, ohlc: DataFrame): return pd.Series((ohlc['high'] + ohlc['low'] + ohlc['close']) / 3, name='TP')；原目录：VFI（period=130, smoothing_factor=3, factor=0.2, vfactor=2.5）；追踪：PF01030；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。

input_roles.definition:
完整数值定义（Python算式/递推；self缓存改为局部变量即可）：self._high=H；self._low=L；self._close=C；self._window=20；self._window_atr=10；self._fillna=False；self._original_version=True；self._multiplier=2；_run: min_periods = 1 if self._fillna else self._window
if self._original_version:
self._tp = ((self._high + self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=min_periods).mean()
self._tp_high = ((4 * self._high - 2 * self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=0).mean()
self._tp_low = ((-2 * self._high + 4 * self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=0).mean()
else:
self._tp = self._close.ewm(span=self._window, min_periods=min_periods, adjust=False).mean()
atr = AverageTrueRange(close=self._close, high=self._high, low=self._low, window=self._window_atr, fillna=self._fillna).average_true_range()
self._tp_high = self._tp + self._multiplier * atr
self._tp_low = self._tp - self._multiplier * atr；keltner_channel_mband: tp_middle = self._check_fillna(self._tp, value=-1)
return pd.Series(tp_middle, name='mavg')；辅助算子 _true_range(high: pd.Series, low: pd.Series, prev_close: pd.Series): tr1 = high - low
tr2 = (high - prev_close).abs()
tr3 = (low - prev_close).abs()
true_range = pd.DataFrame(data={'tr1': tr1, 'tr2': tr2, 'tr3': tr3}).max(axis=1)

input_roles.definition:
固定公开源码默认参数：{'column': 'close'}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：OBV(cls, ohlcv: DataFrame, column: str='close'): ohlcv['OBV'] = np.nan
neg_change = ohlcv[column] < ohlcv[column].shift(1)
pos_change = ohlcv[column] >= ohlcv[column].shift(1)
no_change = ohlcv[column] == ohlcv[column].shift(1)
if pos_change.any():
ohlcv.loc[pos_change, 'OBV'] = ohlcv['volume']
if neg_change.any():
ohlcv.loc[neg_change, 'OBV'] = -ohlcv['volume']
if no_change.any():
ohlcv.loc[no_change, 'OBV'] = ohlcv['OBV'].shift(1)
return pd.Series(ohlcv['OBV'].cumsum(), name='OBV')；原目录：OBV（无固定窗口）；追踪：PF01009；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。

input_roles.name: finta_evwma_20d
input_roles.definition:
固定公开源码默认参数：{'period': 20}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：EVWMA(cls, ohlcv: DataFrame, period: int=20): vol_sum = ohlcv['volume'].rolling(window=period).sum()
x = (vol_sum - ohlcv['volume']) / vol_sum
y = ohlcv['volume'] * ohlcv['close'] / vol_sum
evwma = [0]
for x, y in zip(x.fillna(0).iteritems(), y.iteritems()):
if x[1] == 0 or y[1] == 0:
evwma.append(0)

evwma.append(evwma[-1] * x[1] + y[1])
return pd.Series(evwma[1:], index=ohlcv.index, name='{0} period EVWMA.'.format(period))；原目录：EVWMA（period=20）；追踪：PF00975；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。

input_roles.name: finta_evwma_20d
input_roles.definition:
固定公开源码默认参数：{'period': 20}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：EVWMA(cls, ohlcv: DataFrame, period: int=20): vol_sum = ohlcv['volume'].rolling(window=period).sum()
x = (vol_sum - ohlcv['volume']) / vol_sum
y = ohlcv['volume'] * ohlcv['close'] / vol_sum
evwma = [0]
for x, y in zip(x.fillna(0).iteritems(), y.iteritems()):
if x[1] == 0 or y[1] == 0:
evwma.append(0)
else:
evwma.append(evwma[-1] * x[1] + y[1])

input_roles.name: ta_psar_indicator_psar_down_alld
input_roles.definition:
完整数值定义（Python算式/递推；self缓存改为局部变量即可）：self._high=H；self._low=L；self._close=C；self._step=0.02；self._max_step=0.2；self._fillna=False；_run: up_trend = True
acceleration_factor = self._step
up_trend_high = self._high.iloc[0]
down_trend_low = self._low.iloc[0]
self._psar = self._close.copy()
self._psar_up = pd.Series(index=self._psar.index, dtype='float64')
self._psar_down = pd.Series(index=self._psar.index, dtype='float64')
for i in range(2, len(self._close)):
reversal = False
max_high = self._high.iloc[i]
min_low = self._low.iloc[i]
if up_trend:
self._psar.iloc[i] = self._psar.iloc[i - 1] + acceleration_factor * (up_trend_high - self._psar.iloc[i - 1])
if min_low < self._psar.iloc[i]:
reversal = True
self._psar.iloc[i] = up_trend_high
down_trend_low = min_low
acceleration_factor = self._step
else:
if max_high > up_trend_high:
up_trend_high = max_high
acceleration_factor = min(acceleration_factor + self._step, self._max_step)
low1 = self._low.iloc[i - 1]
low2 = self._low.iloc[i - 2]
if low2 < self._psar.iloc[i]:
self._psar.iloc[i] = low2
elif low1 < self._psar.iloc[i]:
self._psar.iloc[i] = low1
else:
self._psar.iloc[i] = self._psar.iloc[i - 1] - acceleration_factor * (self._psar.iloc[i - 1] - down_trend_low)
if max_high > self._psar.iloc[i]:
reversal = True
self._psar.iloc[i] = down_trend_low
up_trend_high = max_high
acceleration_factor = self._step
else:
if min_low < down_trend_low:
down_trend_low = min_low
acceleration_factor = min(acceleration_factor + self._step, self._max_step)
high1 = self._high.iloc[i - 1]
high2 = self._high.iloc[i - 2]
if high2 > self._psar.iloc[i]:
self._psar[i] = high2
elif high1 > self._psar.iloc[i]:
self._psar.iloc[i] = high1
up_trend = up_trend != reversal
if up_trend:
self._psar_up.iloc[i] = self._psar.iloc[i]
else:
self._psar_down.iloc[i] = self._psar.iloc[i]；psar_down: psar_down_series = self._check_fillna(self._psar_down, value=-1)
return pd.Series(psar_down_series, name='psardown')；self._check_fillna(x,...)在fillna=False时等于x，不执行任何补齐。；原目录：PSARIndicator.psar_down（step=0.02, max_step=0.2）；追踪：PF00932；[来源](https://github.com/bukosabino/ta)。

input_roles.name: ta_keltner_channel_keltner_channel_mband_20_10d
input_roles.definition:
完整数值定义（Python算式/递推；self缓存改为局部变量即可）：self._high=H；self._low=L；self._close=C；self._window=20；self._window_atr=10；self._fillna=False；self._original_version=True；self._multiplier=2；_run: min_periods = 1 if self._fillna else self._window
if self._original_version:
self._tp = ((self._high + self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=min_periods).mean()
self._tp_high = ((4 * self._high - 2 * self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=0).mean()
self._tp_low = ((-2 * self._high + 4 * self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=0).mean()
else:
self._tp = self._close.ewm(span=self._window, min_periods=min_periods, adjust=False).mean()
atr = AverageTrueRange(close=self._close, high=self._high, low=self._low, window=self._window_atr, fillna=self._fillna).average_true_range()
self._tp_high = self._tp + self._multiplier * atr
self._tp_low = self._tp - self._multiplier * atr；keltner_channel_mband: tp_middle = self._check_fillna(self._tp, value=-1)
return pd.Series(tp_middle, name='mavg')；辅助算子 _true_range(high: pd.Series, low: pd.Series, prev_close: pd.Series): tr1 = high - low
tr2 = (high - prev_close).abs()
tr3 = (low - prev_close).abs()
true_range = pd.DataFrame(data={'tr1': tr1, 'tr2': tr2, 'tr3': tr3}).max(axis=1)
return true_range；self._check_fillna(x,...)在fillna=False时等于x，不执行任何补齐。；原目录：KeltnerChannel.keltner_channel_mband（window=20, window_atr=10, original_version=True, multiplier=2）；追踪：PF00894；[来源](https://github.com/bukosabino/ta)。

input_roles.name: ta_kama_indicator_kama_10d
input_roles.definition:
完整数值定义（Python算式/递推；self缓存改为局部变量即可）：self._close=C；self._window=10；self._pow1=2；self._pow2=30；self._fillna=False；_run: close_values = self._close.values
vol = pd.Series(abs(self._close - np.roll(self._close, 1)))
min_periods = 0 if self._fillna else self._window
er_num = abs(close_values - np.roll(close_values, self._window))
er_den = vol.rolling(self._window, min_periods=min_periods).sum()
efficiency_ratio = np.divide(er_num, er_den, out=np.zeros_like(er_num), where=er_den != 0)
smoothing_constant = ((efficiency_ratio * (2.0 / (self._pow1 + 1) - 2.0 / (self._pow2 + 1.0)) + 2 / (self._pow2 + 1.0)) ** 2.0).values
self._kama = np.zeros(smoothing_constant.size)
len_kama = len(self._kama)
first_value = True
for i in range(len_kama):
if np.isnan(smoothing_constant[i]):
self._kama[i] = np.nan
elif first_value:
self._kama[i] = close_values[i]
first_value = False
else:
self._kama[i] = self._kama[i - 1] + smoothing_constant[i] * (close_values[i] - self._kama[i - 1])；kama: kama_series = pd.Series(self._kama, index=self._close.index)
kama_series = self._check_fillna(kama_series, value=self._close)
return pd.Series(kama_series, name='kama')；self._check_fillna(x,...)在fillna=False时等于x，不执行任何补齐。；原目录：KAMAIndicator.kama（window=10, pow1=2, pow2=30）；追踪：PF00952；[来源](https://github.com/bukosabino/ta)。

high = self.high.values

else:

out[:-k] = arr[k:]

return out；to_series(self, arr: Union[list, np.ndarray]): return pd.Series(arr, index=self.close.index).fillna(0)；原目录：atr（窗口=14）；追踪：PF01491；[来源](https://github.com/jealous/stockstats)。

input_roles.definition: 源码算子/递推链：输出=(result_arr, upper_arr, lower_arr)；F = (1.0 - na) * (last_f + last_v + 0.5 * last_a) + na * c_arr[i]；V = (1.0 - nb) * (last_v + last_a) + nb * (F - last_f)；A = (1.0 - nc) * last_a + nc * (V - last_v)；result_arr[i] = F + V + 0.5 * A；var = (1.0 - nd) * last_var + nd * (last_price - last_result) * (last_price - last_result)；stddev = last_var ^ 0.5；upper_arr[i] = result_arr[i] + scalar * stddev；lower_arr[i] = result_arr[i] - scalar * stddev；源码算子/递推链：输出=df；源码算子/递推链：输出=_hwc_build_df(hwc_s, hwc_upper, hwc_lower, hwc_width, hwc_pctwidth, channel_eval)；输出=None；hwc_width = Series(upper_arr - lower_arr, index=close.index)；denom = upper_arr - lower_arr；numer = c_arr - lower_arr；[完整算法/输出列](https://github.com/xgboosted/pandas-ta-classic/blob/74e91a71b56e12ef17a47de42e601d19573ee0fb/pandas_ta_classic/volatility/hwc.py#L75)；完整独立Python定义见本行实现方法指定的数值核；有效参数={'na': 0.2, 'nb': 0.1, 'nc': 0.1, 'nd': 0.1, 'scalar': 1, 'channel_eval': False, 'offset': 0}；只输出'HWM'；原目录：hwc（na=None, nb=None, nc=None, nd=None, scalar=None, channel_eval=None）；追踪：PF01302；[来源](https://github.com/xgboosted/pandas-ta-classic)。

固定公开源码默认参数：{'period': 130, 'smoothing_factor': 3, 'factor': 0.2, 'vfactor': 2.5, 'adjust': True}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：VFI(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=130, smoothing_factor: int=3, factor: int=0.2, vfactor: int=2.5, adjust: bool=True): typical = TA.TP(ohlc)
inter = typical.apply(np.log).diff()
vinter = inter.rolling(window=30).std()
cutoff = pd.Series(factor * vinter * ohlc['close'], name='cutoff')
price_change = pd.Series(typical.diff(), name='pc')
mav = pd.Series(ohlc['volume'].rolling(center=False, window=period).mean(), name='mav')
_va = pd.concat([ohlc['volume'], mav.shift()], axis=1)
_mp = pd.concat([price_change, cutoff], axis=1)
_mp.fillna(value=0, inplace=True)
def _vol_added(row):
""" Determine the maximum volume to be added"""
if row['volume'] > vfactor * row['mav']:
return vfactor * row['mav']
else:
return row['volume']
added_vol = _va.apply(_vol_added, axis=1)
def _multiplier(row):
"""
Determine whether the volume is up volume (multiplier +1) or
down volume (multiplier -1). If price change is smaller than cutoff
do not count volume (multipler 0).
"""
if row['pc'] > row['cutoff']:
return 1
elif row['pc'] < 0 - row['cutoff']:
return -1
else:
return 0
multiplier = _mp.apply(_multiplier, axis=1)
raw_sum = (multiplier * added_vol).rolling(window=period).sum()
raw_value = raw_sum / mav.shift()
vfi = pd.Series(raw_value.ewm(ignore_na=False, min_periods=smoothing_factor - 1, span=smoothing_factor, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='VFI')
return vfi；TP(cls, ohlc: DataFrame): return pd.Series((ohlc['high'] + ohlc['low'] + ohlc['close']) / 3, name='TP')；原目录：VFI（period=130, smoothing_factor=3, factor=0.2, vfactor=2.5）；追踪：PF01030；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。

x = (vol_sum - ohlcv['volume']) / vol_sum
y = ohlcv['volume'] * ohlcv['close'] / vol_sum

for x, y in zip(x.fillna(0).iteritems(), y.iteritems()):

return pd.Series(evwma[1:], index=ohlcv.index, name='{0} period EVWMA.'.format(period))；原目录：EVWMA（period=20）；追踪：PF00975；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。

if self._original_version:
self._tp = ((self._high + self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=min_periods).mean()

atr = AverageTrueRange(close=self._close, high=self._high, low=self._low, window=self._window_atr, fillna=self._fillna).average_true_range()
self._tp_high = self._tp + self._multiplier * atr

wband = self._check_fillna(wband, value=0)
return pd.Series(wband, name='bbiwband')；辅助算子 _true_range(high: pd.Series, low: pd.Series, prev_close: pd.Series): tr1 = high - low

input_roles.definition:
完整数值定义（Python算式/递推；self缓存改为局部变量即可）：self._high=H；self._low=L；self._close=C；self._window=20；self._window_atr=10；self._fillna=False；self._original_version=True；self._multiplier=2；_run: min_periods = 1 if self._fillna else self._window
if self._original_version:
self._tp = ((self._high + self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=min_periods).mean()
self._tp_high = ((4 * self._high - 2 * self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=0).mean()
self._tp_low = ((-2 * self._high + 4 * self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=0).mean()
else:
self._tp = self._close.ewm(span=self._window, min_periods=min_periods, adjust=False).mean()
atr = AverageTrueRange(close=self._close, high=self._high, low=self._low, window=self._window_atr, fillna=self._fillna).average_true_range()
self._tp_high = self._tp + self._multiplier * atr
self._tp_low = self._tp - self._multiplier * atr；keltner_channel_hband: tp_high = self._check_fillna(self._tp_high, value=-1)
return pd.Series(tp_high, name='kc_hband')；辅助算子 _true_range(high: pd.Series, low: pd.Series, prev_close: pd.Series): tr1 = high - low
tr2 = (high - prev_close).abs()
tr3 = (low - prev_close).abs()
true_range = pd.DataFrame(data={'tr1': tr1, 'tr2': tr2, 'tr3': tr3}).max(axis=1)
return true_range；self._check_fillna(x,...)在fillna=False时等于x，不执行任何补齐。；原目录：KeltnerChannel.keltner_channel_hband（window=20, window_atr=10, original_version=True, multiplier=2）；追踪：PF00895；[来源](https://github.com/bukosabino/ta)。

input_roles.definition: 源码算子/递推链：输出=jma；del1 = price - uBand；del2 = price - lBand；v_sum[i] = v_sum[i - 1] + (volty[i] - volty[max(i - sum_length, 0)]) / sum_length；avg_volty = mean(v_sum[max(i - 65, 0):i + 1])；d_volty = 0.0 if avg_volty == 0 else volty[i] / avg_volty；r_volty = max(1.0, min(power(length1, 1.0 / pow1), d_volty))；uBand = price if del1 > 0 else price - kv * del1；lBand = price if del2 < 0 else price - kv * del2；ma1 = (1 - alpha) * price + alpha * ma1；det0 = (price - ma1) * (1 - beta) + beta * det0；ma2 = ma1 + pr * det0；det1 = (ma2 - jma[i - 1]) * (1 - alpha) * (1 - alpha) + alpha * alpha * det1；jma[i] = jma[i - 1] + det1；源码算子/递推链：输出=1.5 + phase * 0.01；输出=0.5；输出=2.5；源码算子/递推链：length = 0.5 * (_length - 1)；length1 = max(log(sqrt(length)) / log(2.0) + 2.0, 0)；pow1 = max(length1 - 2.0, 0.5)；length2 = length1 * sqrt(length)；bet = length2 / (length2 + 1)；beta = 0.45 * (_length - 1) / (0.45 * (_length - 1) + 2.0)；jma[0:_length - 1] = nan；输出=jma；输出=None；[完整算法/输出列](https://github.com/xgboosted/pandas-ta-classic/blob/74e91a71b56e12ef17a47de42e601d19573ee0fb/pandas_ta_classic/overlap/jma.py#L98)；完整独立Python定义见本行实现方法指定的数值核；有效参数={'length': 3.0, 'phase': 0, 'offset': 0}；只输出'JMA_7_0'；原目录：jma（length=None, phase=None）；追踪：PF01230；[来源](https://github.com/xgboosted/pandas-ta-classic)。

input_roles.name: finta_vfi_130d
input_roles.definition:
固定公开源码默认参数：{'period': 130, 'smoothing_factor': 3, 'factor': 0.2, 'vfactor': 2.5, 'adjust': True}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：VFI(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=130, smoothing_factor: int=3, factor: int=0.2, vfactor: int=2.5, adjust: bool=True): typical = TA.TP(ohlc)
inter = typical.apply(np.log).diff()
vinter = inter.rolling(window=30).std()
cutoff = pd.Series(factor * vinter * ohlc['close'], name='cutoff')
price_change = pd.Series(typical.diff(), name='pc')
mav = pd.Series(ohlc['volume'].rolling(center=False, window=period).mean(), name='mav')
_va = pd.concat([ohlc['volume'], mav.shift()], axis=1)
_mp = pd.concat([price_change, cutoff], axis=1)
_mp.fillna(value=0, inplace=True)
def _vol_added(row):
""" Determine the maximum volume to be added"""
if row['volume'] > vfactor * row['mav']:
return vfactor * row['mav']
else:
return row['volume']
added_vol = _va.apply(_vol_added, axis=1)
def _multiplier(row):
"""
Determine whether the volume is up volume (multiplier +1) or
down volume (multiplier -1). If price change is smaller than cutoff
do not count volume (multipler 0).
"""
if row['pc'] > row['cutoff']:
return 1
elif row['pc'] < 0 - row['cutoff']:
return -1
else:
return 0
multiplier = _mp.apply(_multiplier, axis=1)
raw_sum = (multiplier * added_vol).rolling(window=period).sum()
raw_value = raw_sum / mav.shift()
vfi = pd.Series(raw_value.ewm(ignore_na=False, min_periods=smoothing_factor - 1, span=smoothing_factor, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='VFI')
return vfi；TP(cls, ohlc: DataFrame): return pd.Series((ohlc['high'] + ohlc['low'] + ohlc['close']) / 3, name='TP')；原目录：VFI（period=130, smoothing_factor=3, factor=0.2, vfactor=2.5）；追踪：PF01030；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。

input_roles.definition:
完整数值定义（Python算式/递推；self缓存改为局部变量即可）：self._high=H；self._low=L；self._close=C；self._window=20；self._window_atr=10；self._fillna=False；self._original_version=True；self._multiplier=2；_run: min_periods = 1 if self._fillna else self._window
if self._original_version:
self._tp = ((self._high + self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=min_periods).mean()
self._tp_high = ((4 * self._high - 2 * self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=0).mean()
self._tp_low = ((-2 * self._high + 4 * self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=0).mean()
else:
self._tp = self._close.ewm(span=self._window, min_periods=min_periods, adjust=False).mean()
atr = AverageTrueRange(close=self._close, high=self._high, low=self._low, window=self._window_atr, fillna=self._fillna).average_true_range()
self._tp_high = self._tp + self._multiplier * atr
self._tp_low = self._tp - self._multiplier * atr；keltner_channel_wband: wband = (self._tp_high - self._tp_low) / self._tp * 100
wband = self._check_fillna(wband, value=0)
return pd.Series(wband, name='bbiwband')；辅助算子 _true_range(high: pd.Series, low: pd.Series, prev_close: pd.Series): tr1 = high - low
tr2 = (high - prev_close).abs()
tr3 = (low - prev_close).abs()
true_range = pd.DataFrame(data={'tr1': tr1, 'tr2': tr2, 'tr3': tr3}).max(axis=1)
return true_range；self._check_fillna(x,...)在fillna=False时等于x，不执行任何补齐。；原目录：KeltnerChannel.keltner_channel_wband（window=20, window_atr=10, original_version=True, multiplier=2）；追踪：PF00897；[来源](https://github.com/bukosabino/ta)。

input_roles.definition:
固定公开源码默认参数：{'column': 'close'}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：OBV(cls, ohlcv: DataFrame, column: str='close'): ohlcv['OBV'] = np.nan
neg_change = ohlcv[column] < ohlcv[column].shift(1)
pos_change = ohlcv[column] >= ohlcv[column].shift(1)
no_change = ohlcv[column] == ohlcv[column].shift(1)
if pos_change.any():
ohlcv.loc[pos_change, 'OBV'] = ohlcv['volume']
if neg_change.any():
ohlcv.loc[neg_change, 'OBV'] = -ohlcv['volume']
if no_change.any():
ohlcv.loc[no_change, 'OBV'] = ohlcv['OBV'].shift(1)
return pd.Series(ohlcv['OBV'].cumsum(), name='OBV')；原目录：OBV（无固定窗口）；追踪：PF01009；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。

input_roles.name: ta_psar_indicator_psar_down_alld
input_roles.definition:
完整数值定义（Python算式/递推；self缓存改为局部变量即可）：self._high=H；self._low=L；self._close=C；self._step=0.02；self._max_step=0.2；self._fillna=False；_run: up_trend = True
acceleration_factor = self._step
up_trend_high = self._high.iloc[0]
down_trend_low = self._low.iloc[0]
self._psar = self._close.copy()
self._psar_up = pd.Series(index=self._psar.index, dtype='float64')
self._psar_down = pd.Series(index=self._psar.index, dtype='float64')
for i in range(2, len(self._close)):
reversal = False
max_high = self._high.iloc[i]
min_low = self._low.iloc[i]
if up_trend:
self._psar.iloc[i] = self._psar.iloc[i - 1] + acceleration_factor * (up_trend_high - self._psar.iloc[i - 1])
if min_low < self._psar.iloc[i]:
reversal = True
self._psar.iloc[i] = up_trend_high
down_trend_low = min_low
acceleration_factor = self._step
else:
if max_high > up_trend_high:
up_trend_high = max_high
acceleration_factor = min(acceleration_factor + self._step, self._max_step)
low1 = self._low.iloc[i - 1]
low2 = self._low.iloc[i - 2]
if low2 < self._psar.iloc[i]:
self._psar.iloc[i] = low2
elif low1 < self._psar.iloc[i]:
self._psar.iloc[i] = low1
else:
self._psar.iloc[i] = self._psar.iloc[i - 1] - acceleration_factor * (self._psar.iloc[i - 1] - down_trend_low)
if max_high > self._psar.iloc[i]:
reversal = True
self._psar.iloc[i] = down_trend_low
up_trend_high = max_high
acceleration_factor = self._step
else:
if min_low < down_trend_low:
down_trend_low = min_low
acceleration_factor = min(acceleration_factor + self._step, self._max_step)
high1 = self._high.iloc[i - 1]
high2 = self._high.iloc[i - 2]
if high2 > self._psar.iloc[i]:
self._psar[i] = high2
elif high1 > self._psar.iloc[i]:
self._psar.iloc[i] = high1
up_trend = up_trend != reversal
if up_trend:
self._psar_up.iloc[i] = self._psar.iloc[i]
else:
self._psar_down.iloc[i] = self._psar.iloc[i]；psar_down: psar_down_series = self._check_fillna(self._psar_down, value=-1)
return pd.Series(psar_down_series, name='psardown')；self._check_fillna(x,...)在fillna=False时等于x，不执行任何补齐。；原目录：PSARIndicator.psar_down（step=0.02, max_step=0.2）；追踪：PF00932；[来源](https://github.com/bukosabino/ta)。

if self._original_version:

atr = AverageTrueRange(close=self._close, high=self._high, low=self._low, window=self._window_atr, fillna=self._fillna).average_true_range()

input_roles.name: finta_vfi_130d
input_roles.definition:
固定公开源码默认参数：{'period': 130, 'smoothing_factor': 3, 'factor': 0.2, 'vfactor': 2.5, 'adjust': True}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：VFI(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=130, smoothing_factor: int=3, factor: int=0.2, vfactor: int=2.5, adjust: bool=True): typical = TA.TP(ohlc)
inter = typical.apply(np.log).diff()
vinter = inter.rolling(window=30).std()
cutoff = pd.Series(factor * vinter * ohlc['close'], name='cutoff')
price_change = pd.Series(typical.diff(), name='pc')
mav = pd.Series(ohlc['volume'].rolling(center=False, window=period).mean(), name='mav')
_va = pd.concat([ohlc['volume'], mav.shift()], axis=1)
_mp = pd.concat([price_change, cutoff], axis=1)
_mp.fillna(value=0, inplace=True)
def _vol_added(row):
""" Determine the maximum volume to be added"""
if row['volume'] > vfactor * row['mav']:
return vfactor * row['mav']
else:
return row['volume']
added_vol = _va.apply(_vol_added, axis=1)
def _multiplier(row):
"""
Determine whether the volume is up volume (multiplier +1) or
down volume (multiplier -1). If price change is smaller than cutoff
do not count volume (multipler 0).
"""
if row['pc'] > row['cutoff']:
return 1
elif row['pc'] < 0 - row['cutoff']:
return -1
else:
return 0
multiplier = _mp.apply(_multiplier, axis=1)
raw_sum = (multiplier * added_vol).rolling(window=period).sum()
raw_value = raw_sum / mav.shift()
vfi = pd.Series(raw_value.ewm(ignore_na=False, min_periods=smoothing_factor - 1, span=smoothing_factor, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='VFI')
return vfi；TP(cls, ohlc: DataFrame): return pd.Series((ohlc['high'] + ohlc['low'] + ohlc['close']) / 3, name='TP')；原目录：VFI（period=130, smoothing_factor=3, factor=0.2, vfactor=2.5）；追踪：PF01030；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。

input_roles.name: ta_kama_indicator_kama_10d
input_roles.definition:
完整数值定义（Python算式/递推；self缓存改为局部变量即可）：self._close=C；self._window=10；self._pow1=2；self._pow2=30；self._fillna=False；_run: close_values = self._close.values
vol = pd.Series(abs(self._close - np.roll(self._close, 1)))
min_periods = 0 if self._fillna else self._window
er_num = abs(close_values - np.roll(close_values, self._window))
er_den = vol.rolling(self._window, min_periods=min_periods).sum()
efficiency_ratio = np.divide(er_num, er_den, out=np.zeros_like(er_num), where=er_den != 0)
smoothing_constant = ((efficiency_ratio * (2.0 / (self._pow1 + 1) - 2.0 / (self._pow2 + 1.0)) + 2 / (self._pow2 + 1.0)) ** 2.0).values
self._kama = np.zeros(smoothing_constant.size)
len_kama = len(self._kama)
first_value = True
for i in range(len_kama):
if np.isnan(smoothing_constant[i]):
self._kama[i] = np.nan
elif first_value:
self._kama[i] = close_values[i]
first_value = False
else:
self._kama[i] = self._kama[i - 1] + smoothing_constant[i] * (close_values[i] - self._kama[i - 1])；kama: kama_series = pd.Series(self._kama, index=self._close.index)
kama_series = self._check_fillna(kama_series, value=self._close)
return pd.Series(kama_series, name='kama')；self._check_fillna(x,...)在fillna=False时等于x，不执行任何补齐。；原目录：KAMAIndicator.kama（window=10, pow1=2, pow2=30）；追踪：PF00952；[来源](https://github.com/bukosabino/ta)。

true_range = self._true_range(self._high, self._low, close_shift)
atr = np.zeros(len(self._close))
atr[self._window - 1] = true_range[0:self._window].mean()
for i in range(self._window, len(atr)):
atr[i] = (atr[i - 1] * (self._window - 1) + true_range.iloc[i]) / float(self._window)
self._atr = pd.Series(data=atr, index=true_range.index)；average_true_range: atr = self._check_fillna(self._atr, value=0)
return pd.Series(atr, name='atr')；辅助算子 _true_range(high: pd.Series, low: pd.Series, prev_close: pd.Series): tr1 = high - low
tr2 = (high - prev_close).abs()
tr3 = (low - prev_close).abs()
true_range = pd.DataFrame(data={'tr1': tr1, 'tr2': tr2, 'tr3': tr3}).max(axis=1)
return true_range；self._check_fillna(x,...)在fillna=False时等于x，不执行任何补齐。；原目录：AverageTrueRange.average_true_range（window=14）；追踪：PF00887；[来源](https://github.com/bukosabino/ta)。

input_roles.definition:
完整数值定义（Python算式/递推；self缓存改为局部变量即可）：self._high=H；self._low=L；self._close=C；self._window=20；self._window_atr=10；self._fillna=False；self._original_version=True；self._multiplier=2；_run: min_periods = 1 if self._fillna else self._window
if self._original_version:
self._tp = ((self._high + self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=min_periods).mean()
self._tp_high = ((4 * self._high - 2 * self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=0).mean()
self._tp_low = ((-2 * self._high + 4 * self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=0).mean()
else:
self._tp = self._close.ewm(span=self._window, min_periods=min_periods, adjust=False).mean()
atr = AverageTrueRange(close=self._close, high=self._high, low=self._low, window=self._window_atr, fillna=self._fillna).average_true_range()
self._tp_high = self._tp + self._multiplier * atr
self._tp_low = self._tp - self._multiplier * atr；keltner_channel_lband: tp_low = self._check_fillna(self._tp_low, value=-1)
return pd.Series(tp_low, name='kc_lband')；辅助算子 _true_range(high: pd.Series, low: pd.Series, prev_close: pd.Series): tr1 = high - low
tr2 = (high - prev_close).abs()
tr3 = (low - prev_close).abs()
true_range = pd.DataFrame(data={'tr1': tr1, 'tr2': tr2, 'tr3': tr3}).max(axis=1)
return true_range；self._check_fillna(x,...)在fillna=False时等于x，不执行任何补齐。；原目录：KeltnerChannel.keltner_channel_lband（window=20, window_atr=10, original_version=True, multiplier=2）；追踪：PF00896；[来源](https://github.com/bukosabino/ta)。

if self._original_version:
self._tp = ((self._high + self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=min_periods).mean()
self._tp_high = ((4 * self._high - 2 * self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=0).mean()
self._tp_low = ((-2 * self._high + 4 * self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=0).mean()
else:
self._tp = self._close.ewm(span=self._window, min_periods=min_periods, adjust=False).mean()
atr = AverageTrueRange(close=self._close, high=self._high, low=self._low, window=self._window_atr, fillna=self._fillna).average_true_range()
self._tp_high = self._tp + self._multiplier * atr
self._tp_low = self._tp - self._multiplier * atr；keltner_channel_mband: tp_middle = self._check_fillna(self._tp, value=-1)
return pd.Series(tp_middle, name='mavg')；辅助算子 _true_range(high: pd.Series, low: pd.Series, prev_close: pd.Series): tr1 = high - low
tr2 = (high - prev_close).abs()
tr3 = (low - prev_close).abs()
true_range = pd.DataFrame(data={'tr1': tr1, 'tr2': tr2, 'tr3': tr3}).max(axis=1)
return true_range；self._check_fillna(x,...)在fillna=False时等于x，不执行任何补齐。；原目录：KeltnerChannel.keltner_channel_mband（window=20, window_atr=10, original_version=True, multiplier=2）；追踪：PF00894；[来源](https://github.com/bukosabino/ta)。

input_roles.name: finta_vfi_130d
input_roles.definition:
固定公开源码默认参数：{'period': 130, 'smoothing_factor': 3, 'factor': 0.2, 'vfactor': 2.5, 'adjust': True}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：VFI(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=130, smoothing_factor: int=3, factor: int=0.2, vfactor: int=2.5, adjust: bool=True): typical = TA.TP(ohlc)
inter = typical.apply(np.log).diff()
vinter = inter.rolling(window=30).std()
cutoff = pd.Series(factor * vinter * ohlc['close'], name='cutoff')
price_change = pd.Series(typical.diff(), name='pc')
mav = pd.Series(ohlc['volume'].rolling(center=False, window=period).mean(), name='mav')
_va = pd.concat([ohlc['volume'], mav.shift()], axis=1)
_mp = pd.concat([price_change, cutoff], axis=1)
_mp.fillna(value=0, inplace=True)
def _vol_added(row):
""" Determine the maximum volume to be added"""
if row['volume'] > vfactor * row['mav']:
return vfactor * row['mav']
else:
return row['volume']
added_vol = _va.apply(_vol_added, axis=1)
def _multiplier(row):
"""
Determine whether the volume is up volume (multiplier +1) or
down volume (multiplier -1). If price change is smaller than cutoff
do not count volume (multipler 0).
"""
if row['pc'] > row['cutoff']:
return 1
elif row['pc'] < 0 - row['cutoff']:
return -1
else:
return 0
multiplier = _mp.apply(_multiplier, axis=1)
raw_sum = (multiplier * added_vol).rolling(window=period).sum()
raw_value = raw_sum / mav.shift()
vfi = pd.Series(raw_value.ewm(ignore_na=False, min_periods=smoothing_factor - 1, span=smoothing_factor, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='VFI')
return vfi；TP(cls, ohlc: DataFrame): return pd.Series((ohlc['high'] + ohlc['low'] + ohlc['close']) / 3, name='TP')；原目录：VFI（period=130, smoothing_factor=3, factor=0.2, vfactor=2.5）；追踪：PF01030；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。

固定公开源码默认参数：{'period': 20}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：EVWMA(cls, ohlcv: DataFrame, period: int=20): vol_sum = ohlcv['volume'].rolling(window=period).sum()
x = (vol_sum - ohlcv['volume']) / vol_sum
y = ohlcv['volume'] * ohlcv['close'] / vol_sum
evwma = [0]
for x, y in zip(x.fillna(0).iteritems(), y.iteritems()):
if x[1] == 0 or y[1] == 0:
evwma.append(0)
else:
evwma.append(evwma[-1] * x[1] + y[1])
return pd.Series(evwma[1:], index=ohlcv.index, name='{0} period EVWMA.'.format(period))；原目录：EVWMA（period=20）；追踪：PF00975；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。

input_roles.name: ta_keltner_channel_keltner_channel_wband_20_10d
input_roles.definition:
完整数值定义（Python算式/递推；self缓存改为局部变量即可）：self._high=H；self._low=L；self._close=C；self._window=20；self._window_atr=10；self._fillna=False；self._original_version=True；self._multiplier=2；_run: min_periods = 1 if self._fillna else self._window
if self._original_version:
self._tp = ((self._high + self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=min_periods).mean()
self._tp_high = ((4 * self._high - 2 * self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=0).mean()
self._tp_low = ((-2 * self._high + 4 * self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=0).mean()
else:
self._tp = self._close.ewm(span=self._window, min_periods=min_periods, adjust=False).mean()
atr = AverageTrueRange(close=self._close, high=self._high, low=self._low, window=self._window_atr, fillna=self._fillna).average_true_range()
self._tp_high = self._tp + self._multiplier * atr
self._tp_low = self._tp - self._multiplier * atr；keltner_channel_wband: wband = (self._tp_high - self._tp_low) / self._tp * 100
wband = self._check_fillna(wband, value=0)
return pd.Series(wband, name='bbiwband')；辅助算子 _true_range(high: pd.Series, low: pd.Series, prev_close: pd.Series): tr1 = high - low
tr2 = (high - prev_close).abs()
tr3 = (low - prev_close).abs()
true_range = pd.DataFrame(data={'tr1': tr1, 'tr2': tr2, 'tr3': tr3}).max(axis=1)
return true_range；self._check_fillna(x,...)在fillna=False时等于x，不执行任何补齐。；原目录：KeltnerChannel.keltner_channel_wband（window=20, window_atr=10, original_version=True, multiplier=2）；追踪：PF00897；[来源](https://github.com/bukosabino/ta)。

input_roles.name: finta_vfi_130d
input_roles.definition:
固定公开源码默认参数：{'period': 130, 'smoothing_factor': 3, 'factor': 0.2, 'vfactor': 2.5, 'adjust': True}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：VFI(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=130, smoothing_factor: int=3, factor: int=0.2, vfactor: int=2.5, adjust: bool=True): typical = TA.TP(ohlc)
inter = typical.apply(np.log).diff()
vinter = inter.rolling(window=30).std()
cutoff = pd.Series(factor * vinter * ohlc['close'], name='cutoff')
price_change = pd.Series(typical.diff(), name='pc')
mav = pd.Series(ohlc['volume'].rolling(center=False, window=period).mean(), name='mav')
_va = pd.concat([ohlc['volume'], mav.shift()], axis=1)
_mp = pd.concat([price_change, cutoff], axis=1)
_mp.fillna(value=0, inplace=True)
def _vol_added(row):
""" Determine the maximum volume to be added"""
if row['volume'] > vfactor * row['mav']:
return vfactor * row['mav']
else:
return row['volume']
added_vol = _va.apply(_vol_added, axis=1)
def _multiplier(row):
"""
Determine whether the volume is up volume (multiplier +1) or
down volume (multiplier -1). If price change is smaller than cutoff
do not count volume (multipler 0).
"""
if row['pc'] > row['cutoff']:
return 1
elif row['pc'] < 0 - row['cutoff']:
return -1
else:
return 0
multiplier = _mp.apply(_multiplier, axis=1)
raw_sum = (multiplier * added_vol).rolling(window=period).sum()
raw_value = raw_sum / mav.shift()
vfi = pd.Series(raw_value.ewm(ignore_na=False, min_periods=smoothing_factor - 1, span=smoothing_factor, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='VFI')
return vfi；TP(cls, ohlc: DataFrame): return pd.Series((ohlc['high'] + ohlc['low'] + ohlc['close']) / 3, name='TP')；原目录：VFI（period=130, smoothing_factor=3, factor=0.2, vfactor=2.5）；追踪：PF01030；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。

固定公开源码默认参数：{'column': 'close'}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：OBV(cls, ohlcv: DataFrame, column: str='close'): ohlcv['OBV'] = np.nan
neg_change = ohlcv[column] < ohlcv[column].shift(1)
pos_change = ohlcv[column] >= ohlcv[column].shift(1)
no_change = ohlcv[column] == ohlcv[column].shift(1)
if pos_change.any():
ohlcv.loc[pos_change, 'OBV'] = ohlcv['volume']
if neg_change.any():
ohlcv.loc[neg_change, 'OBV'] = -ohlcv['volume']
if no_change.any():
ohlcv.loc[no_change, 'OBV'] = ohlcv['OBV'].shift(1)
return pd.Series(ohlcv['OBV'].cumsum(), name='OBV')；原目录：OBV（无固定窗口）；追踪：PF01009；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。

input_roles.definition:
完整数值定义（Python算式/递推；self缓存改为局部变量即可）：self._high=H；self._low=L；self._close=C；self._window=20；self._window_atr=10；self._fillna=False；self._original_version=True；self._multiplier=2；_run: min_periods = 1 if self._fillna else self._window
if self._original_version:
self._tp = ((self._high + self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=min_periods).mean()
self._tp_high = ((4 * self._high - 2 * self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=0).mean()
self._tp_low = ((-2 * self._high + 4 * self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=0).mean()
else:
self._tp = self._close.ewm(span=self._window, min_periods=min_periods, adjust=False).mean()
atr = AverageTrueRange(close=self._close, high=self._high, low=self._low, window=self._window_atr, fillna=self._fillna).average_true_range()
self._tp_high = self._tp + self._multiplier * atr
self._tp_low = self._tp - self._multiplier * atr；keltner_channel_hband: tp_high = self._check_fillna(self._tp_high, value=-1)
return pd.Series(tp_high, name='kc_hband')；辅助算子 _true_range(high: pd.Series, low: pd.Series, prev_close: pd.Series): tr1 = high - low
tr2 = (high - prev_close).abs()
tr3 = (low - prev_close).abs()
true_range = pd.DataFrame(data={'tr1': tr1, 'tr2': tr2, 'tr3': tr3}).max(axis=1)
return true_range；self._check_fillna(x,...)在fillna=False时等于x，不执行任何补齐。；原目录：KeltnerChannel.keltner_channel_hband（window=20, window_atr=10, original_version=True, multiplier=2）；追踪：PF00895；[来源](https://github.com/bukosabino/ta)。

input_roles.name: finta_vfi_130d
input_roles.definition:
固定公开源码默认参数：{'period': 130, 'smoothing_factor': 3, 'factor': 0.2, 'vfactor': 2.5, 'adjust': True}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：VFI(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=130, smoothing_factor: int=3, factor: int=0.2, vfactor: int=2.5, adjust: bool=True): typical = TA.TP(ohlc)
inter = typical.apply(np.log).diff()
vinter = inter.rolling(window=30).std()
cutoff = pd.Series(factor * vinter * ohlc['close'], name='cutoff')
price_change = pd.Series(typical.diff(), name='pc')
mav = pd.Series(ohlc['volume'].rolling(center=False, window=period).mean(), name='mav')
_va = pd.concat([ohlc['volume'], mav.shift()], axis=1)
_mp = pd.concat([price_change, cutoff], axis=1)
_mp.fillna(value=0, inplace=True)
def _vol_added(row):
""" Determine the maximum volume to be added"""
if row['volume'] > vfactor * row['mav']:
return vfactor * row['mav']
else:
return row['volume']
added_vol = _va.apply(_vol_added, axis=1)
def _multiplier(row):
"""
Determine whether the volume is up volume (multiplier +1) or
down volume (multiplier -1). If price change is smaller than cutoff
do not count volume (multipler 0).
"""
if row['pc'] > row['cutoff']:
return 1
elif row['pc'] < 0 - row['cutoff']:
return -1
else:
return 0
multiplier = _mp.apply(_multiplier, axis=1)
raw_sum = (multiplier * added_vol).rolling(window=period).sum()
raw_value = raw_sum / mav.shift()
vfi = pd.Series(raw_value.ewm(ignore_na=False, min_periods=smoothing_factor - 1, span=smoothing_factor, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='VFI')
return vfi；TP(cls, ohlc: DataFrame): return pd.Series((ohlc['high'] + ohlc['low'] + ohlc['close']) / 3, name='TP')；原目录：VFI（period=130, smoothing_factor=3, factor=0.2, vfactor=2.5）；追踪：PF01030；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。

input_roles.name: ta_kama_indicator_kama_10d
input_roles.definition:
完整数值定义（Python算式/递推；self缓存改为局部变量即可）：self._close=C；self._window=10；self._pow1=2；self._pow2=30；self._fillna=False；_run: close_values = self._close.values
vol = pd.Series(abs(self._close - np.roll(self._close, 1)))
min_periods = 0 if self._fillna else self._window
er_num = abs(close_values - np.roll(close_values, self._window))
er_den = vol.rolling(self._window, min_periods=min_periods).sum()
efficiency_ratio = np.divide(er_num, er_den, out=np.zeros_like(er_num), where=er_den != 0)
smoothing_constant = ((efficiency_ratio * (2.0 / (self._pow1 + 1) - 2.0 / (self._pow2 + 1.0)) + 2 / (self._pow2 + 1.0)) ** 2.0).values
self._kama = np.zeros(smoothing_constant.size)
len_kama = len(self._kama)
first_value = True
for i in range(len_kama):
if np.isnan(smoothing_constant[i]):
self._kama[i] = np.nan
elif first_value:
self._kama[i] = close_values[i]
first_value = False
else:
self._kama[i] = self._kama[i - 1] + smoothing_constant[i] * (close_values[i] - self._kama[i - 1])；kama: kama_series = pd.Series(self._kama, index=self._close.index)
kama_series = self._check_fillna(kama_series, value=self._close)
return pd.Series(kama_series, name='kama')；self._check_fillna(x,...)在fillna=False时等于x，不执行任何补齐。；原目录：KAMAIndicator.kama（window=10, pow1=2, pow2=30）；追踪：PF00952；[来源](https://github.com/bukosabino/ta)。

input_roles.name: finta_obv_alld
input_roles.definition:
固定公开源码默认参数：{'column': 'close'}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：OBV(cls, ohlcv: DataFrame, column: str='close'): ohlcv['OBV'] = np.nan
neg_change = ohlcv[column] < ohlcv[column].shift(1)
pos_change = ohlcv[column] >= ohlcv[column].shift(1)
no_change = ohlcv[column] == ohlcv[column].shift(1)
if pos_change.any():
ohlcv.loc[pos_change, 'OBV'] = ohlcv['volume']
if neg_change.any():
ohlcv.loc[neg_change, 'OBV'] = -ohlcv['volume']
if no_change.any():
ohlcv.loc[no_change, 'OBV'] = ohlcv['OBV'].shift(1)
return pd.Series(ohlcv['OBV'].cumsum(), name='OBV')；原目录：OBV（无固定窗口）；追踪：PF01009；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。

input_roles.name: ptac_hwc_hwl_alld
input_roles.definition: 源码算子/递推链：输出=(result_arr, upper_arr, lower_arr)；F = (1.0 - na) * (last_f + last_v + 0.5 * last_a) + na * c_arr[i]；V = (1.0 - nb) * (last_v + last_a) + nb * (F - last_f)；A = (1.0 - nc) * last_a + nc * (V - last_v)；result_arr[i] = F + V + 0.5 * A；var = (1.0 - nd) * last_var + nd * (last_price - last_result) * (last_price - last_result)；stddev = last_var ^ 0.5；upper_arr[i] = result_arr[i] + scalar * stddev；lower_arr[i] = result_arr[i] - scalar * stddev；源码算子/递推链：输出=df；源码算子/递推链：输出=_hwc_build_df(hwc_s, hwc_upper, hwc_lower, hwc_width, hwc_pctwidth, channel_eval)；输出=None；hwc_width = Series(upper_arr - lower_arr, index=close.index)；denom = upper_arr - lower_arr；numer = c_arr - lower_arr；[完整算法/输出列](https://github.com/xgboosted/pandas-ta-classic/blob/74e91a71b56e12ef17a47de42e601d19573ee0fb/pandas_ta_classic/volatility/hwc.py#L75)；完整独立Python定义见本行实现方法指定的数值核；有效参数={'na': 0.2, 'nb': 0.1, 'nc': 0.1, 'nd': 0.1, 'scalar': 1, 'channel_eval': False, 'offset': 0}；只输出'HWL'；原目录：hwc（na=None, nb=None, nc=None, nd=None, scalar=None, channel_eval=None）；追踪：PF01302；[来源](https://github.com/xgboosted/pandas-ta-classic)。

input_roles.name: finta_atr_14d
input_roles.definition:
固定公开源码默认参数：{'period': 14}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：ATR(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=14): TR = cls.TR(ohlc)
return pd.Series(TR.rolling(center=False, window=period).mean(), name='{0} period ATR'.format(period))；TR(cls, ohlc: DataFrame): TR1 = pd.Series(ohlc['high'] - ohlc['low']).abs()

_TR['TR'] = _TR.max(axis=1)
return pd.Series(_TR['TR'], name='TR')；原目录：ATR（period=14）；追踪：PF00987；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。

input_roles.name: ta_keltner_channel_keltner_channel_wband_20_10d
input_roles.definition:
完整数值定义（Python算式/递推；self缓存改为局部变量即可）：self._high=H；self._low=L；self._close=C；self._window=20；self._window_atr=10；self._fillna=False；self._original_version=True；self._multiplier=2；_run: min_periods = 1 if self._fillna else self._window
if self._original_version:
self._tp = ((self._high + self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=min_periods).mean()
self._tp_high = ((4 * self._high - 2 * self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=0).mean()
self._tp_low = ((-2 * self._high + 4 * self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=0).mean()
else:
self._tp = self._close.ewm(span=self._window, min_periods=min_periods, adjust=False).mean()
atr = AverageTrueRange(close=self._close, high=self._high, low=self._low, window=self._window_atr, fillna=self._fillna).average_true_range()
self._tp_high = self._tp + self._multiplier * atr
self._tp_low = self._tp - self._multiplier * atr；keltner_channel_wband: wband = (self._tp_high - self._tp_low) / self._tp * 100
wband = self._check_fillna(wband, value=0)
return pd.Series(wband, name='bbiwband')；辅助算子 _true_range(high: pd.Series, low: pd.Series, prev_close: pd.Series): tr1 = high - low
tr2 = (high - prev_close).abs()
tr3 = (low - prev_close).abs()
true_range = pd.DataFrame(data={'tr1': tr1, 'tr2': tr2, 'tr3': tr3}).max(axis=1)
return true_range；self._check_fillna(x,...)在fillna=False时等于x，不执行任何补齐。；原目录：KeltnerChannel.keltner_channel_wband（window=20, window_atr=10, original_version=True, multiplier=2）；追踪：PF00897；[来源](https://github.com/bukosabino/ta)。

vol_decrease = self._volume.shift(1) > self._volume
self._nvi = pd.Series(data=np.nan, index=self._close.index, dtype='float64', name='nvi')
self._nvi.iloc[0] = 1000
for i in range(1, len(self._nvi)):
if vol_decrease.iloc[i]:
self._nvi.iloc[i] = self._nvi.iloc[i - 1] * (1.0 + price_change.iloc[i])
else:

input_roles.name: ta_keltner_channel_keltner_channel_mband_20_10d
input_roles.definition:
完整数值定义（Python算式/递推；self缓存改为局部变量即可）：self._high=H；self._low=L；self._close=C；self._window=20；self._window_atr=10；self._fillna=False；self._original_version=True；self._multiplier=2；_run: min_periods = 1 if self._fillna else self._window
if self._original_version:
self._tp = ((self._high + self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=min_periods).mean()
self._tp_high = ((4 * self._high - 2 * self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=0).mean()
self._tp_low = ((-2 * self._high + 4 * self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=0).mean()
else:
self._tp = self._close.ewm(span=self._window, min_periods=min_periods, adjust=False).mean()
atr = AverageTrueRange(close=self._close, high=self._high, low=self._low, window=self._window_atr, fillna=self._fillna).average_true_range()
self._tp_high = self._tp + self._multiplier * atr
self._tp_low = self._tp - self._multiplier * atr；keltner_channel_mband: tp_middle = self._check_fillna(self._tp, value=-1)
return pd.Series(tp_middle, name='mavg')；辅助算子 _true_range(high: pd.Series, low: pd.Series, prev_close: pd.Series): tr1 = high - low
tr2 = (high - prev_close).abs()
tr3 = (low - prev_close).abs()
true_range = pd.DataFrame(data={'tr1': tr1, 'tr2': tr2, 'tr3': tr3}).max(axis=1)
return true_range；self._check_fillna(x,...)在fillna=False时等于x，不执行任何补齐。；原目录：KeltnerChannel.keltner_channel_mband（window=20, window_atr=10, original_version=True, multiplier=2）；追踪：PF00894；[来源](https://github.com/bukosabino/ta)。

input_roles.definition: 源码算子/递推链：输出=(result_arr, upper_arr, lower_arr)；F = (1.0 - na) * (last_f + last_v + 0.5 * last_a) + na * c_arr[i]；V = (1.0 - nb) * (last_v + last_a) + nb * (F - last_f)；A = (1.0 - nc) * last_a + nc * (V - last_v)；result_arr[i] = F + V + 0.5 * A；var = (1.0 - nd) * last_var + nd * (last_price - last_result) * (last_price - last_result)；stddev = last_var ^ 0.5；upper_arr[i] = result_arr[i] + scalar * stddev；lower_arr[i] = result_arr[i] - scalar * stddev；源码算子/递推链：输出=df；源码算子/递推链：输出=_hwc_build_df(hwc_s, hwc_upper, hwc_lower, hwc_width, hwc_pctwidth, channel_eval)；输出=None；hwc_width = Series(upper_arr - lower_arr, index=close.index)；denom = upper_arr - lower_arr；numer = c_arr - lower_arr；[完整算法/输出列](https://github.com/xgboosted/pandas-ta-classic/blob/74e91a71b56e12ef17a47de42e601d19573ee0fb/pandas_ta_classic/volatility/hwc.py#L75)；完整独立Python定义见本行实现方法指定的数值核；有效参数={'na': 0.2, 'nb': 0.1, 'nc': 0.1, 'nd': 0.1, 'scalar': 1, 'channel_eval': False, 'offset': 0}；只输出'HWM'；原目录：hwc（na=None, nb=None, nc=None, nd=None, scalar=None, channel_eval=None）；追踪：PF01302；[来源](https://github.com/xgboosted/pandas-ta-classic)。

input_roles.definition: 源码算子/递推链：输出=(result_arr, upper_arr, lower_arr)；F = (1.0 - na) * (last_f + last_v + 0.5 * last_a) + na * c_arr[i]；V = (1.0 - nb) * (last_v + last_a) + nb * (F - last_f)；A = (1.0 - nc) * last_a + nc * (V - last_v)；result_arr[i] = F + V + 0.5 * A；var = (1.0 - nd) * last_var + nd * (last_price - last_result) * (last_price - last_result)；stddev = last_var ^ 0.5；upper_arr[i] = result_arr[i] + scalar * stddev；lower_arr[i] = result_arr[i] - scalar * stddev；源码算子/递推链：输出=df；源码算子/递推链：输出=_hwc_build_df(hwc_s, hwc_upper, hwc_lower, hwc_width, hwc_pctwidth, channel_eval)；输出=None；hwc_width = Series(upper_arr - lower_arr, index=close.index)；denom = upper_arr - lower_arr；numer = c_arr - lower_arr；[完整算法/输出列](https://github.com/xgboosted/pandas-ta-classic/blob/74e91a71b56e12ef17a47de42e601d19573ee0fb/pandas_ta_classic/volatility/hwc.py#L75)；完整独立Python定义见本行实现方法指定的数值核；有效参数={'na': 0.2, 'nb': 0.1, 'nc': 0.1, 'nd': 0.1, 'scalar': 1, 'channel_eval': False, 'offset': 0}；只输出'HWU'；原目录：hwc（na=None, nb=None, nc=None, nd=None, scalar=None, channel_eval=None）；追踪：PF01302；[来源](https://github.com/xgboosted/pandas-ta-classic)。

完整数值定义（Python算式/递推；self缓存改为局部变量即可）：self._high=H；self._low=L；self._close=C；self._window=20；self._window_atr=10；self._fillna=False；self._original_version=True；self._multiplier=2；_run: min_periods = 1 if self._fillna else self._window
if self._original_version:
self._tp = ((self._high + self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=min_periods).mean()
self._tp_high = ((4 * self._high - 2 * self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=0).mean()
self._tp_low = ((-2 * self._high + 4 * self._low + self._close) / 3.0).rolling(self._window, min_periods=0).mean()
else:
self._tp = self._close.ewm(span=self._window, min_periods=min_periods, adjust=False).mean()
atr = AverageTrueRange(close=self._close, high=self._high, low=self._low, window=self._window_atr, fillna=self._fillna).average_true_range()
self._tp_high = self._tp + self._multiplier * atr
self._tp_low = self._tp - self._multiplier * atr；keltner_channel_hband: tp_high = self._check_fillna(self._tp_high, value=-1)
return pd.Series(tp_high, name='kc_hband')；辅助算子 _true_range(high: pd.Series, low: pd.Series, prev_close: pd.Series): tr1 = high - low
tr2 = (high - prev_close).abs()
tr3 = (low - prev_close).abs()
true_range = pd.DataFrame(data={'tr1': tr1, 'tr2': tr2, 'tr3': tr3}).max(axis=1)
return true_range；self._check_fillna(x,...)在fillna=False时等于x，不执行任何补齐。；原目录：KeltnerChannel.keltner_channel_hband（window=20, window_atr=10, original_version=True, multiplier=2）；追踪：PF00895；[来源](https://github.com/bukosabino/ta)。

neg_change = ohlcv[column] < ohlcv[column].shift(1)

input_roles.name: ptac_jma_jma_7_0_3d
input_roles.definition: 源码算子/递推链：输出=jma；del1 = price - uBand；del2 = price - lBand；v_sum[i] = v_sum[i - 1] + (volty[i] - volty[max(i - sum_length, 0)]) / sum_length；avg_volty = mean(v_sum[max(i - 65, 0):i + 1])；d_volty = 0.0 if avg_volty == 0 else volty[i] / avg_volty；r_volty = max(1.0, min(power(length1, 1.0 / pow1), d_volty))；uBand = price if del1 > 0 else price - kv * del1；lBand = price if del2 < 0 else price - kv * del2；ma1 = (1 - alpha) * price + alpha * ma1；det0 = (price - ma1) * (1 - beta) + beta * det0；ma2 = ma1 + pr * det0；det1 = (ma2 - jma[i - 1]) * (1 - alpha) * (1 - alpha) + alpha * alpha * det1；jma[i] = jma[i - 1] + det1；源码算子/递推链：输出=1.5 + phase * 0.01；输出=0.5；输出=2.5；源码算子/递推链：length = 0.5 * (_length - 1)；length1 = max(log(sqrt(length)) / log(2.0) + 2.0, 0)；pow1 = max(length1 - 2.0, 0.5)；length2 = length1 * sqrt(length)；bet = length2 / (length2 + 1)；beta = 0.45 * (_length - 1) / (0.45 * (_length - 1) + 2.0)；jma[0:_length - 1] = nan；输出=jma；输出=None；[完整算法/输出列](https://github.com/xgboosted/pandas-ta-classic/blob/74e91a71b56e12ef17a47de42e601d19573ee0fb/pandas_ta_classic/overlap/jma.py#L98)；完整独立Python定义见本行实现方法指定的数值核；有效参数={'length': 3.0, 'phase': 0, 'offset': 0}；只输出'JMA_7_0'；原目录：jma（length=None, phase=None）；追踪：PF01230；[来源](https://github.com/xgboosted/pandas-ta-classic)。

input_roles.name: ta_psar_indicator_psar_up_alld
input_roles.definition:
完整数值定义（Python算式/递推；self缓存改为局部变量即可）：self._high=H；self._low=L；self._close=C；self._step=0.02；self._max_step=0.2；self._fillna=False；_run: up_trend = True
acceleration_factor = self._step
up_trend_high = self._high.iloc[0]
down_trend_low = self._low.iloc[0]
self._psar = self._close.copy()
self._psar_up = pd.Series(index=self._psar.index, dtype='float64')
self._psar_down = pd.Series(index=self._psar.index, dtype='float64')
for i in range(2, len(self._close)):
reversal = False
max_high = self._high.iloc[i]
min_low = self._low.iloc[i]
if up_trend:
self._psar.iloc[i] = self._psar.iloc[i - 1] + acceleration_factor * (up_trend_high - self._psar.iloc[i - 1])
if min_low < self._psar.iloc[i]:
reversal = True
self._psar.iloc[i] = up_trend_high
down_trend_low = min_low
acceleration_factor = self._step
else:
if max_high > up_trend_high:
up_trend_high = max_high
acceleration_factor = min(acceleration_factor + self._step, self._max_step)
low1 = self._low.iloc[i - 1]
low2 = self._low.iloc[i - 2]
if low2 < self._psar.iloc[i]:
self._psar.iloc[i] = low2
elif low1 < self._psar.iloc[i]:
self._psar.iloc[i] = low1
else:
self._psar.iloc[i] = self._psar.iloc[i - 1] - acceleration_factor * (self._psar.iloc[i - 1] - down_trend_low)
if max_high > self._psar.iloc[i]:
reversal = True
self._psar.iloc[i] = down_trend_low
up_trend_high = max_high
acceleration_factor = self._step
else:
if min_low < down_trend_low:
down_trend_low = min_low
acceleration_factor = min(acceleration_factor + self._step, self._max_step)
high1 = self._high.iloc[i - 1]
high2 = self._high.iloc[i - 2]
if high2 > self._psar.iloc[i]:
self._psar[i] = high2
elif high1 > self._psar.iloc[i]:
self._psar.iloc[i] = high1
up_trend = up_trend != reversal
if up_trend:
self._psar_up.iloc[i] = self._psar.iloc[i]
else:
self._psar_down.iloc[i] = self._psar.iloc[i]；psar_up: psar_up_series = self._check_fillna(self._psar_up, value=-1)
return pd.Series(psar_up_series, name='psarup')；self._check_fillna(x,...)在fillna=False时等于x，不执行任何补齐。；原目录：PSARIndicator.psar_up（step=0.02, max_step=0.2）；追踪：PF00931；[来源](https://github.com/bukosabino/ta)。

input_roles.name: finta_vfi_130d
input_roles.definition:
固定公开源码默认参数：{'period': 130, 'smoothing_factor': 3, 'factor': 0.2, 'vfactor': 2.5, 'adjust': True}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：VFI(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=130, smoothing_factor: int=3, factor: int=0.2, vfactor: int=2.5, adjust: bool=True): typical = TA.TP(ohlc)
inter = typical.apply(np.log).diff()
vinter = inter.rolling(window=30).std()
cutoff = pd.Series(factor * vinter * ohlc['close'], name='cutoff')
price_change = pd.Series(typical.diff(), name='pc')
mav = pd.Series(ohlc['volume'].rolling(center=False, window=period).mean(), name='mav')
_va = pd.concat([ohlc['volume'], mav.shift()], axis=1)
_mp = pd.concat([price_change, cutoff], axis=1)
_mp.fillna(value=0, inplace=True)
def _vol_added(row):
""" Determine the maximum volume to be added"""
if row['volume'] > vfactor * row['mav']:
return vfactor * row['mav']
else:
return row['volume']
added_vol = _va.apply(_vol_added, axis=1)
def _multiplier(row):
"""
Determine whether the volume is up volume (multiplier +1) or
down volume (multiplier -1). If price change is smaller than cutoff
do not count volume (multipler 0).
"""
if row['pc'] > row['cutoff']:
return 1
elif row['pc'] < 0 - row['cutoff']:
return -1
else:
return 0
multiplier = _mp.apply(_multiplier, axis=1)
raw_sum = (multiplier * added_vol).rolling(window=period).sum()
raw_value = raw_sum / mav.shift()
vfi = pd.Series(raw_value.ewm(ignore_na=False, min_periods=smoothing_factor - 1, span=smoothing_factor, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='VFI')
return vfi；TP(cls, ohlc: DataFrame): return pd.Series((ohlc['high'] + ohlc['low'] + ohlc['close']) / 3, name='TP')；原目录：VFI（period=130, smoothing_factor=3, factor=0.2, vfactor=2.5）；追踪：PF01030；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。

vol = pd.Series(abs(self._close - np.roll(self._close, 1)))
min_periods = 0 if self._fillna else self._window
er_num = abs(close_values - np.roll(close_values, self._window))
er_den = vol.rolling(self._window, min_periods=min_periods).sum()
efficiency_ratio = np.divide(er_num, er_den, out=np.zeros_like(er_num), where=er_den != 0)
smoothing_constant = ((efficiency_ratio * (2.0 / (self._pow1 + 1) - 2.0 / (self._pow2 + 1.0)) + 2 / (self._pow2 + 1.0)) ** 2.0).values
self._kama = np.zeros(smoothing_constant.size)
len_kama = len(self._kama)
first_value = True
for i in range(len_kama):
if np.isnan(smoothing_constant[i]):
self._kama[i] = np.nan
elif first_value:
self._kama[i] = close_values[i]
first_value = False
else:
self._kama[i] = self._kama[i - 1] + smoothing_constant[i] * (close_values[i] - self._kama[i - 1])；kama: kama_series = pd.Series(self._kama, index=self._close.index)
kama_series = self._check_fillna(kama_series, value=self._close)
return pd.Series(kama_series, name='kama')；self._check_fillna(x,...)在fillna=False时等于x，不执行任何补齐。；原目录：KAMAIndicator.kama（window=10, pow1=2, pow2=30）；追踪：PF00952；[来源](https://github.com/bukosabino/ta)。

input_roles.name: finta_vfi_130d
input_roles.definition:
固定公开源码默认参数：{'period': 130, 'smoothing_factor': 3, 'factor': 0.2, 'vfactor': 2.5, 'adjust': True}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：VFI(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=130, smoothing_factor: int=3, factor: int=0.2, vfactor: int=2.5, adjust: bool=True): typical = TA.TP(ohlc)
inter = typical.apply(np.log).diff()
vinter = inter.rolling(window=30).std()
cutoff = pd.Series(factor * vinter * ohlc['close'], name='cutoff')
price_change = pd.Series(typical.diff(), name='pc')
mav = pd.Series(ohlc['volume'].rolling(center=False, window=period).mean(), name='mav')
_va = pd.concat([ohlc['volume'], mav.shift()], axis=1)
_mp = pd.concat([price_change, cutoff], axis=1)
_mp.fillna(value=0, inplace=True)
def _vol_added(row):
""" Determine the maximum volume to be added"""
if row['volume'] > vfactor * row['mav']:
return vfactor * row['mav']
else:
return row['volume']
added_vol = _va.apply(_vol_added, axis=1)
def _multiplier(row):
"""
Determine whether the volume is up volume (multiplier +1) or
down volume (multiplier -1). If price change is smaller than cutoff
do not count volume (multipler 0).
"""
if row['pc'] > row['cutoff']:
return 1
elif row['pc'] < 0 - row['cutoff']:
return -1
else:
return 0
multiplier = _mp.apply(_multiplier, axis=1)
raw_sum = (multiplier * added_vol).rolling(window=period).sum()
raw_value = raw_sum / mav.shift()
vfi = pd.Series(raw_value.ewm(ignore_na=False, min_periods=smoothing_factor - 1, span=smoothing_factor, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='VFI')
return vfi；TP(cls, ohlc: DataFrame): return pd.Series((ohlc['high'] + ohlc['low'] + ohlc['close']) / 3, name='TP')；原目录：VFI（period=130, smoothing_factor=3, factor=0.2, vfactor=2.5）；追踪：PF01030；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。

input_roles.name: ptac_jma_jma_7_0_3d
input_roles.definition: 源码算子/递推链：输出=jma；del1 = price - uBand；del2 = price - lBand；v_sum[i] = v_sum[i - 1] + (volty[i] - volty[max(i - sum_length, 0)]) / sum_length；avg_volty = mean(v_sum[max(i - 65, 0):i + 1])；d_volty = 0.0 if avg_volty == 0 else volty[i] / avg_volty；r_volty = max(1.0, min(power(length1, 1.0 / pow1), d_volty))；uBand = price if del1 > 0 else price - kv * del1；lBand = price if del2 < 0 else price - kv * del2；ma1 = (1 - alpha) * price + alpha * ma1；det0 = (price - ma1) * (1 - beta) + beta * det0；ma2 = ma1 + pr * det0；det1 = (ma2 - jma[i - 1]) * (1 - alpha) * (1 - alpha) + alpha * alpha * det1；jma[i] = jma[i - 1] + det1；源码算子/递推链：输出=1.5 + phase * 0.01；输出=0.5；输出=2.5；源码算子/递推链：length = 0.5 * (_length - 1)；length1 = max(log(sqrt(length)) / log(2.0) + 2.0, 0)；pow1 = max(length1 - 2.0, 0.5)；length2 = length1 * sqrt(length)；bet = length2 / (length2 + 1)；beta = 0.45 * (_length - 1) / (0.45 * (_length - 1) + 2.0)；jma[0:_length - 1] = nan；输出=jma；输出=None；[完整算法/输出列](https://github.com/xgboosted/pandas-ta-classic/blob/74e91a71b56e12ef17a47de42e601d19573ee0fb/pandas_ta_classic/overlap/jma.py#L98)；完整独立Python定义见本行实现方法指定的数值核；有效参数={'length': 3.0, 'phase': 0, 'offset': 0}；只输出'JMA_7_0'；原目录：jma（length=None, phase=None）；追踪：PF01230；[来源](https://github.com/xgboosted/pandas-ta-classic)。

input_roles.name: ta_psar_indicator_psar_alld
input_roles.definition:
完整数值定义（Python算式/递推；self缓存改为局部变量即可）：self._high=H；self._low=L；self._close=C；self._step=0.02；self._max_step=0.2；self._fillna=False；_run: up_trend = True
acceleration_factor = self._step
up_trend_high = self._high.iloc[0]
down_trend_low = self._low.iloc[0]
self._psar = self._close.copy()
self._psar_up = pd.Series(index=self._psar.index, dtype='float64')
self._psar_down = pd.Series(index=self._psar.index, dtype='float64')
for i in range(2, len(self._close)):
reversal = False
max_high = self._high.iloc[i]
min_low = self._low.iloc[i]
if up_trend:
self._psar.iloc[i] = self._psar.iloc[i - 1] + acceleration_factor * (up_trend_high - self._psar.iloc[i - 1])
if min_low < self._psar.iloc[i]:
reversal = True
self._psar.iloc[i] = up_trend_high
down_trend_low = min_low
acceleration_factor = self._step
else:
if max_high > up_trend_high:
up_trend_high = max_high
acceleration_factor = min(acceleration_factor + self._step, self._max_step)
low1 = self._low.iloc[i - 1]
low2 = self._low.iloc[i - 2]
if low2 < self._psar.iloc[i]:
self._psar.iloc[i] = low2
elif low1 < self._psar.iloc[i]:
self._psar.iloc[i] = low1
else:
self._psar.iloc[i] = self._psar.iloc[i - 1] - acceleration_factor * (self._psar.iloc[i - 1] - down_trend_low)
if max_high > self._psar.iloc[i]:
reversal = True
self._psar.iloc[i] = down_trend_low
up_trend_high = max_high
acceleration_factor = self._step
else:
if min_low < down_trend_low:
down_trend_low = min_low
acceleration_factor = min(acceleration_factor + self._step, self._max_step)
high1 = self._high.iloc[i - 1]
high2 = self._high.iloc[i - 2]
if high2 > self._psar.iloc[i]:
self._psar[i] = high2
elif high1 > self._psar.iloc[i]:
self._psar.iloc[i] = high1
up_trend = up_trend != reversal
if up_trend:
self._psar_up.iloc[i] = self._psar.iloc[i]
else:
self._psar_down.iloc[i] = self._psar.iloc[i]；psar: psar_series = self._check_fillna(self._psar, value=-1)

input_roles.name: finta_vfi_130d
input_roles.definition:
固定公开源码默认参数：{'period': 130, 'smoothing_factor': 3, 'factor': 0.2, 'vfactor': 2.5, 'adjust': True}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：VFI(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=130, smoothing_factor: int=3, factor: int=0.2, vfactor: int=2.5, adjust: bool=True): typical = TA.TP(ohlc)
inter = typical.apply(np.log).diff()
vinter = inter.rolling(window=30).std()
cutoff = pd.Series(factor * vinter * ohlc['close'], name='cutoff')
price_change = pd.Series(typical.diff(), name='pc')
mav = pd.Series(ohlc['volume'].rolling(center=False, window=period).mean(), name='mav')
_va = pd.concat([ohlc['volume'], mav.shift()], axis=1)
_mp = pd.concat([price_change, cutoff], axis=1)
_mp.fillna(value=0, inplace=True)
def _vol_added(row):
""" Determine the maximum volume to be added"""
if row['volume'] > vfactor * row['mav']:
return vfactor * row['mav']
else:
return row['volume']
added_vol = _va.apply(_vol_added, axis=1)
def _multiplier(row):
"""
Determine whether the volume is up volume (multiplier +1) or
down volume (multiplier -1). If price change is smaller than cutoff
do not count volume (multipler 0).
"""
if row['pc'] > row['cutoff']:
return 1
elif row['pc'] < 0 - row['cutoff']:
return -1
else:
return 0
multiplier = _mp.apply(_multiplier, axis=1)
raw_sum = (multiplier * added_vol).rolling(window=period).sum()
raw_value = raw_sum / mav.shift()
vfi = pd.Series(raw_value.ewm(ignore_na=False, min_periods=smoothing_factor - 1, span=smoothing_factor, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='VFI')
return vfi；TP(cls, ohlc: DataFrame): return pd.Series((ohlc['high'] + ohlc['low'] + ohlc['close']) / 3, name='TP')；原目录：VFI（period=130, smoothing_factor=3, factor=0.2, vfactor=2.5）；追踪：PF01030；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。

input_roles.name: finta_vfi_130d
input_roles.definition:
固定公开源码默认参数：{'period': 130, 'smoothing_factor': 3, 'factor': 0.2, 'vfactor': 2.5, 'adjust': True}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：VFI(cls, ohlc: DataFrame, period: int=130, smoothing_factor: int=3, factor: int=0.2, vfactor: int=2.5, adjust: bool=True): typical = TA.TP(ohlc)
inter = typical.apply(np.log).diff()
vinter = inter.rolling(window=30).std()
cutoff = pd.Series(factor * vinter * ohlc['close'], name='cutoff')
price_change = pd.Series(typical.diff(), name='pc')
mav = pd.Series(ohlc['volume'].rolling(center=False, window=period).mean(), name='mav')
_va = pd.concat([ohlc['volume'], mav.shift()], axis=1)
_mp = pd.concat([price_change, cutoff], axis=1)
_mp.fillna(value=0, inplace=True)
def _vol_added(row):
""" Determine the maximum volume to be added"""
if row['volume'] > vfactor * row['mav']:
return vfactor * row['mav']
else:
return row['volume']
added_vol = _va.apply(_vol_added, axis=1)
def _multiplier(row):
"""
Determine whether the volume is up volume (multiplier +1) or
down volume (multiplier -1). If price change is smaller than cutoff
do not count volume (multipler 0).
"""
if row['pc'] > row['cutoff']:
return 1
elif row['pc'] < 0 - row['cutoff']:
return -1
else:
return 0
multiplier = _mp.apply(_multiplier, axis=1)
raw_sum = (multiplier * added_vol).rolling(window=period).sum()
raw_value = raw_sum / mav.shift()
vfi = pd.Series(raw_value.ewm(ignore_na=False, min_periods=smoothing_factor - 1, span=smoothing_factor, adjust=adjust).mean(), name='VFI')
return vfi；TP(cls, ohlc: DataFrame): return pd.Series((ohlc['high'] + ohlc['low'] + ohlc['close']) / 3, name='TP')；原目录：VFI（period=130, smoothing_factor=3, factor=0.2, vfactor=2.5）；追踪：PF01030；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。

input_roles.definition:
固定公开源码默认参数：{'column': 'close'}；完整数值递推及依赖（Series/DataFrame仅为本地临时计算结构）：OBV(cls, ohlcv: DataFrame, column: str='close'): ohlcv['OBV'] = np.nan
neg_change = ohlcv[column] < ohlcv[column].shift(1)
pos_change = ohlcv[column] >= ohlcv[column].shift(1)
no_change = ohlcv[column] == ohlcv[column].shift(1)
if pos_change.any():
ohlcv.loc[pos_change, 'OBV'] = ohlcv['volume']
if neg_change.any():
ohlcv.loc[neg_change, 'OBV'] = -ohlcv['volume']
if no_change.any():
ohlcv.loc[no_change, 'OBV'] = ohlcv['OBV'].shift(1)
return pd.Series(ohlcv['OBV'].cumsum(), name='OBV')；原目录：OBV（无固定窗口）；追踪：PF01009；[来源](https://github.com/peerchemist/finta)。
